title: 2 Day Hobbiton Waitomo Caves Raglan Private Tour from Hamilton
blurb:
This two-day private tour from Hamilton showcases some of the most iconic and beautiful destinations in New Zealand’s central North Island.

Day One begins with a guided tour of the famous Hobbiton Movie Set, where you’ll step into the world of the Shire. After lunch, visit the crystal-clear Blue Spring in Putāruru, followed by the spectacular Waitomo Glowworm Caves Guided Tour. Conclude with a relaxing overnight stay in Hamilton.

Day Two takes you to the coastal charm of Raglan, starting with the breathtaking Bridal Veil Falls. Enjoy the beauty of Ngarunui Beach, dramatic views from Te Toto Gorge Lookout, and the local vibe at Raglan's beachfront playground. Stop for lunch at Raglan Wharf before heading along the scenic coast to Port Waikato, where you’ll visit Sunset Beach and the vast sand dunes, before returning to Hamilton.

This tour blends natural wonders, cinematic sites, and coastal charm—perfect for travelers seeking a well-rounded North Island experience in just two days.
